Nasdaq flagged noncompliance on Sept 22, 2025 after 30 consecutive business days with close < $1.00.
Company received two 180-day cure periods, first until Mar 23, 2026, then extended to Sept 21, 2026.
From Aug 27 to Sept 10, 2026 the stock closed ≥ $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, restoring compliance.
Nasdaq notified Longeveron on Sept 11, 2026 that the matter is closed following regained compliance.
